description.value: Your follower acts as a poison taster, checking your and your companions' food before you eat, and carrying solutions to poison when you need it. Every day, your follower creates a number of antidotes and antiplagues equal to your party size, of an item level equal to your level. Your follower has a +2 circumstance bonus to detect poison or disease in your meals, and samples your and your allies' meals every day.
